title: Copilot is just a fancy autocomplete (vol.2)
summary: Copilot's Agent mode has become the primary approach for AL development over Edits, using AI-assisted tools for code generation and project management. The post recommends settings like Todo List Tool and Max Requests, paired with copilot-instructions.md files, specific LLM models (Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-5, Grok), and MCP servers for enhanced developer productivity.
key_points: Agent mode with built-in tools has replaced Edits as the preferred Copilot workflow for AL development
Enable Todo List Tool and increase Max Requests setting to 100 for uninterrupted task execution
Use copilot-instructions.md files and project overview instructions to guide consistent code generation
Claude Sonnet 4 is recommended as the default model; GPT-5 and Grok Code Fast 1 are reliable alternatives
MCP servers (GitHub/Azure DevOps, Microsoft Docs, Al-symbols-mcp, Bc-code-intelligence-mcp, Serena) extend agent capabilities but should be used selectively to preserve context window
